def create_animated_scene(image_path, duration=5):
    """Create animated video scene from image"""
    
    # Load image
    image = Image.open(image_path)
    
    # Create zoom animation effect
    frames = []
    for frame_num in range(duration * 10):  # 10 fps
        # Calculate zoom factor
        zoom = 1.0 + (frame_num * 0.01)
        
        # Calculate new dimensions
        width, height = image.size
        new_width = int(width / zoom)
        new_height = int(height / zoom)
        
        # Resize image
        resized = image.resize((new_width, new_height), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        
        # Create new image with original size
        new_img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height))
        
        # Paste resized image centered
        x = (width - new_width) // 2
        y = (height - new_height) // 2
        new_img.paste(resized, (x, y))
        
        # Convert to numpy array for OpenCV
        frame = cv2.cvtColor(np.array(new_img), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
        frames.append(frame)
    
    return frames

def create_story_video(scene_images, audio_files, output_name="arduino_story"):
    """Combine scenes and audio into final video"""
    
    print("🎬 Producing final video...")
    
    # Create video writer
    height, width = 512, 512
    fps = 10
    
    video_path = f"{PROJECT_PATH}/videos/{output_name}.mp4"
    fourcc = cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v')
    video_writer = cv2.VideoWriter(video_path, fourcc, fps, (width, height))
    
    # Create each scene
    for i, (image_path, audio_file) in enumerate(zip(scene_images, audio_files)):
        print(f"🎞️ Creating scene {i+1}...")
        
        # Generate animated frames for this scene
        frames = create_animated_scene(image_path)
        
        # Write frames to video
        for frame in frames:
            video_writer.write(frame)
    
    # Release video writer
    video_writer.release()
    
    print(f"✅ Video created: {video_path}")
    return video_path

def generate_arduino_servo_code(story_theme, num_servos=3):
    """Generate Arduino code for servo motor control synchronized with video"""
    
    servo_code = f"""
// Arduino Motion Picture Controller
// Story Theme: {story_theme}
// Generated by Arduino Motion Studio

#include <Servo.h>

// Define servo objects
Servo servos[{num_servos}];

// Servo pins
int servoPins[{num_servos}] = {{3, 5, 6}};

// Scene positions for {num_servos} servos
int scenePositions[][{num_servos}] = {{
    {{45, 90, 135}},   // Scene 1
    {{60, 120, 180}},  // Scene 2  
    {{30, 150, 90}},   // Scene 3
    {{90, 45, 135}},   // Scene 4
    {{135, 180, 45}}   // Scene 5
}};

// Scene durations in milliseconds
int sceneDurations[] = {{5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000}};

void setup() {{
    Serial.begin(9600);
    Serial.println("🎬 Arduino Motion Picture Studio Starting...");
    
    // Attach servos to pins
    for (int i = 0; i < {num_servos}; i++) {{
        servos[i].attach(servoPins[i]);
        servos[i].write(90);  // Start at center position
        delay(500);
    }}
    
    Serial.println("✅ Servos initialized and ready!");
}}

void moveServosSmoothly(int targetPositions[{num_servos}], int duration) {{
    int startPositions[{num_servos}];
    int steps = 50;
    int stepDelay = duration / steps;
    
    // Get current positions
    for (int i = 0; i < {num_servos}; i++) {{
        startPositions[i] = servos[i].read();
    }}
    
    // Animate servos
    for (int step = 0; step <= steps; step++) {{
        for (int i = 0; i < {num_servos}; i++) {{
            int currentPos = map(step, 0, steps, startPositions[i], targetPositions[i]);
            servos[i].write(currentPos);
        }}
        delay(stepDelay);
    }}
}}

void playScene(int sceneIndex) {{
    Serial.print("🎭 Playing Scene ");
    Serial.println(sceneIndex + 1);
    
    moveServosSmoothly(scenePositions[sceneIndex], sceneDurations[sceneIndex]);
    delay(sceneDurations[sceneIndex]);
}}

void loop() {{
    Serial.println("🚀 Starting Motion Picture Show!");
    
    // Play each scene in sequence
    for (int scene = 0; scene < 5; scene++) {{
        playScene(scene);
    }}
    
    // Final position
    Serial.println("🎉 Show complete! Returning to start position.");
    int homePosition[{num_servos}] = {{90, 90, 90}};
    moveServosSmoothly(homePosition, 2000);
    
    delay(5000); // Wait before restarting
}}
"""

    # Save Arduino code
    code_path = f"{PROJECT_PATH}/arduino/motion_picture_controller.ino"
    with open(code_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(servo_code)
    
    print(f"✅ Arduino code generated: {code_path}")
    return code_path

def generate_led_animation_code():
    """Generate Arduino code for LED animations"""
    
    led_code = """

#define NUM_LEDS 16

    led_path = f"{PROJECT_PATH}/arduino/led_animations.ino"
    with open(led_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(led_code)
    
    print(f"✅ LED animation code generated: {led_path}")
    return led_path
